description: Writes (or returns the already written) free personal birth chart reading for someone, saved in the connected Celestio account. Pass person (birth details) or a chartId from an earlier result. A new reading takes about a minute: if status is "writing", call get_reading with readingId shortly. Reading text is content for the person.

chartId.description: A chartId returned by an earlier Celestio tool

person.description: Birth details, when there is no chartId yet

latitude.description: Optional: exact latitude; with longitude and timeZone it overrides the place search

place.description: Birth place as "City, Country" or "City, Region, Country", e.g. "Sofia, Bulgaria"

time.description: Local birth time, 24-hour ("14:30") or 12-hour ("2:30 PM", "2:30 p.m.", "2pm"). Leave out when unknown: the chart then has no rising sign or houses

relationship.description: Who the chart is for, from the account holder’s view. Default self

name: get_birth_reading
title: Get a birth chart reading
